title: react-world-map-extended: country data
description: Your own data for the map: the properties to show (each with the colour of its scale) and a row of numbers per country. Not expressible here and checked by `validateCountryData`: a property name may appear only once and may not be `country` or `infoLink`; the country code must be a country on the map and may appear only once (the first row is used); each listed property needs a number in at least one row, and each row a number for at least one listed property.

name.description: The property's name in the rows. It is the label in the details and in the dropdown.

color.description: Hex colour of the scale: the highest number gets it, the lowest a light tint of it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (FR) or alpha-3 (FRA) code, any case. Names are not accepted.

infoLink.description: Optional. Shown as a link in the details when it is an http(s) URL.

additionalProperties.description: The number of a listed property (null: no value). Other properties are ignored.
